title: Radiation-assisted electrochemical reduction of CO2 to CO
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,424-431
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00484A, Communication
Ryan P. Morco, Luis A. Diaz, Maria Magdalena Ramirez-Corredores
Ionizing radiation can enhance the yield of carbon monoxide (CO, a versatile intermediate feedstock) produced from the electrochemical reduction of carbon dioxide (CO2).
